_about: Tests that still read the playtest town. tools\cli test runs them in a second boot on DebugWorld; every other WORLD and PERSISTENCE test boots GridWorld (tools/lib/test-world.mjs, docs/architecture/three-worlds.md). Seeded from the W1 GridWorld failures (#1803) plus the town tests added since (#1804). Remove a pin when its test gains grid fixtures; the list should end empty.
